fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Stages/maps (story stages, challenge/carnage stages, post-game/DLC scenario maps, Trials, hubs, Item World rooms). map_id selects Map/map%05d (.hex/.chr/.gop/.obf) - enemies/geo panels are in the map files, not here. Netherworld text (WorldMapHelpDataBase id 1000+N) corresponds to map_id//100-1 (40xx -> 1029). Quest.unlock_stage refers to stage_key; Quest cond_type 4 targets and QuestEnemy.map refer to map_id; talk.dat entry ids are map ids.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: row id = row index 0..222

fields.name: map_id
fields.desc: map file number: _extracted/Map/Map_JP/map%05d (verified 214/223 exist; 80001 Reward Room, 90001 Unique Dungeon (random), demo/dummy maps missing). Stage number convention: episode*100+stage (101..1607), 17xx-29xx post-game/DLC, 21xx trials, 30xxx hub halls, 40xxx Item World rooms, 50001 Innocent Farm

fields.name: unk_008
fields.desc: 0 for challenge/carnage/post-game/hub maps; story stages have values like 103,205,603,704,1204,1701..1705,1801..1810 (1801-1806 on each episode final stage, 1806-1810 on the five Trials), 1811 on all "(Demo)" maps, 3001 when unk_00C is set; looks like an event/scene id (not a BGM file, not a FlagList id, not a talk.dat id)

fields.name: unk_00C
fields.desc: non-zero only when unk_008==3001: 14xxx (14000=FLAG_FACILITY_ITEMWORLD, 14001 GROUP, 14008 ASSEMBLY, 14009 QUEST_SHOP, 14010 SKILL, 14053/14063/14065/14067 *_READ flags) or 22015..22031; probably a flag/tutorial id triggered at this stage

fields.name: weather_effect
fields.desc: ambient map effect id = effect%04d.obf / EffectTableDataBase id (2000 poison (Poison Beach), 2001 spores (Demunshroom), 1003 snow (Icic-Hell), 1000/1002 heat, 1004 wind, 2002 ghosts ...); 0 = none

fields.name: episode
fields.desc: 0-based story episode (0 = Ep.1 ... 15 = finale), 16 = post-game/DLC, 17 = Trials, 65535 = not a battle map (hubs, Item World rooms)

fields.name: stage_key
fields.desc: stage id used by Quest.unlock_stage (5000+episode*10+stage: 5011..5402, 4099 test map); 0 for demo/hub maps

fields.name: stage_rank
fields.desc: 1..37 difficulty tier, rises ~every 2 story stages (Ep1 1-2 ... Ep15 31-33, post-game 33-36, Baal 37); challenge stages 24-34. Possibly indexes Enemy_Parameters_TableDataBase group 1 (ids 1..40) / drop item rank

fields.name: camera_angle
fields.desc: initial camera yaw in degrees (315 default, 225 Trials, 45 "Researching Love", 0 hubs)

fields.name: is_story_stage
fields.desc: 1 = regular stage (story / post-game), 0 = challenge/carnage/demo/test/hub

fields.name: stage_type
fields.desc: 0 normal, 1 extra (challenge stages, overlord fights, post-game), 2 carnage (Carnage stages, Song of Calamity)

fields.name: point1_x
fields.desc: coordinate-like byte, 255 = unused (set on 9 stages only: 106,502,703,1003,1005,1303,1501,1506); pairs with point1_y
